visual_review: Inspected complete final wall. Four earth-pigment stones in one bowl added on bare upper-left rock. Inherited heavy-lidded wide-mouth Pepe and all earlier marks retained. image_method: Built-in imagegen transparent pigment generation, then Node compositing on bare rock.

preservation: 9531 changed pixels in [100,165,190,110]; zero changed pixels outside. Pepe, existing pigment, framing and dimensions retained.
